Vitality Medical
sells and distributes wearable medical devices
, specifically focusing on portable and wearable patient monitors like wrist-worn pulse oximeters, continuous vital sign monitors, and related diagnostic health tracking equipment.
Vitality Medical
Types of Wearable Medical Devices Offered
Wrist-Worn Pulse Oximeters:
Compact, watch-style devices designed for continuous real-time tracking of blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and pulse rate (such as the Nonin WristOx2 series).
Remote Health Monitors:
Portable and wearable sensors intended for outpatient, home, or clinical activity and vital sign tracking.
Oximetry Sensors & Accessories:
Reusable and disposable finger/wrist sensors compatible with mobile or portable monitoring units.
Vitality Medical

Vitality Medical
supplies diverse home healthcare and diabetic management products, but
it does not manufacture or specialize in high-tech consumer smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or advanced sleep-tracking rings
. Modern remote patient monitoring (RPM) and biometric tracking rely on dedicated specialized devices rather than a single unified platform.
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
Function:
Wearable biosensors placed on the skin (like the upper arm) to measure interstitial fluid glucose levels 24/7.
Examples:
Abbott FreeStyle Libre and Dexcom G7/Stelo systems.
Usage:
Transmits real-time data to a smartphone app to track spikes, crashes, and trends without routine finger-pricks.

Smartwatches & Wearable ECGs
Function:
Wrist-bound devices that monitor real-time heart rates, blood oxygen (SpO2), and record single-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) to spot irregularities like atrial fibrillation.

Sleep Trackers & RPM Platforms
Function:
Dedicated rings, bands, or clinical biosensors (such as disposable chest/arm patches) that monitor multi-variable vitals—including skin temperature, sleep stages, respiratory rate, and heart rate variability (HRV).
